entries.title: The claimed core boundary omits native primitives and a bootstrap ABI
entries.change: Native apply/scan and identified primitives are no longer excluded as library-only. OC-BOOTSTRAP/OC-ACTOR remain.

entries.title: AfterEval has the wrong method key
entries.change: Unqualified BeforeEval/AfterEval keys, exact arguments and result roles.

entries.title: Standalone semicolons are incorrectly accepted by the source-unit grammar
entries.change: No standalone-semicolon skipping; source-unit and parse-utility observations kept separate.

entries.title: Loop control cannot be specified by a uniform innermost-loop rule
entries.change: Ten clause rows define bare/valued continue and break; domain/iterator boundary remains OC-ITERATOR.

entries.title: The typed completion taxonomy changes try on step and finish
entries.change: Step/finish caught under active suppression; datatype split does not define catchability; OC-DEBUG retained.

entries.title: The second left evaluation of <=/>= does not obey blanket error propagation
entries.change: First comparison checked; second delivered lhs result inspected without blanket abrupt check, including interval branches.

entries.title: Binding failure effects and traversal are not optional
entries.change: RHS precedes method-capability validation, explicit early branches preserved; full remaining low-level edges OC-BIND.

entries.title: Assignment-hook lookup time is unspecified
entries.change: Capture old release before symbol hooks; late new-class assignment lookup.

entries.title: Symbol identity immutability is conflated with isMutable
entries.change: Native isMutable representation predicate separated from stable identity.

entries.title: CacheTable equality omits class and parent conditions
entries.change: Class and parent checks precede exact-class hash-zero CacheTable special case.

entries.title: Augmented Default dispatch is name-based, not canonical-symbol identity
entries.change: Canonical word bytes Default request fallback; not one distinguished global identity.

entries.title: Augmented hash-table assignment needs an explicit operand schedule
entries.change: HashTable container -> RHS -> key -> lookup schedule and cached-vs-other paths; remaining edges OC-AUGMENT.

entries.title: Not every assignment expression returns its supplied RHS
entries.change: Per-form result rules; recursive actual results and one-target unwrapping replace universal RHS claim.

entries.title: Reflective frame APIs have aliasing semantics, not just display semantics
entries.change: Shared backing sequence, existing-slot writes and global hiding required; extension/stale/empty-frame boundary OC-FRAME.

entries.title: Dictionary history, enumeration and cardinality are not fixed by “shadowing map”
entries.change: Retained duplicate entries/counts separated from lookup; full erase/rehash/enumeration policy OC-DICT.

entries.title: Source-unit hook failures and wrappers need a total policy table
entries.change: Hook substitutions/continuation, wrapper transfer set, exit and close precedence integrated; OC-UNIT/OC-DEBUG remain.

entries.title: Actor and host interfaces are named but not completely contracted
entries.change: Partial bootstrap register and actor/host/numeric open contracts replace an unsupported completeness claim.

entries.title: Method state and class hash tables need one authoritative view
entries.change: Class/object tables authoritative; indexes/caches derived. Full installation edge contract OC-INSTALL remains.

entries.title: Strict native conformance and intentional safe departures need separate labels
entries.change: PN and PS profiles with explicit departures/domain boundaries; no arbitrary cleanup permission.

entries.title: The structural validator misses inconsistencies within its own data boundary
entries.change: Active table/JSON agreement, exact quote-word policy, routes, checksum and HTML source binding checks; behavior remains unvalidated.

entries.title: The 146-case corpus is a test plan, not an executable conformance oracle
entries.change: Exact-source and controlled configuration fixtures are unexecuted; legacy 146-case plan archived, complete native harness/coverage pending.

entries.title: The normative organization duplicates too much and obscures authority
entries.change: One active contract, separate architecture and non-normative ledger/archive; no verbatim normative Annex A.

entries.title: Do not make every logical identity a mandatory hot-path allocation
entries.change: Logical addresses can be activation/slot; no mandatory per-cell object or redundant ID on each hot read.

entries.title: The proof roadmap has no fully defined runtime transition relation to refine yet
entries.change: Known transitions fixed; no full runtime relation/proof claimed until OC-* contracts close.
